about: Per resolve class, the largest difference in any channel (0-255) a backend's pixel may show against the reference pixel of that class. All are placeholders until the cross-architecture measurement sets them. Coverage starts at the core's COVERAGE_TO_SAMPLE_LSB, which bounds the coverage resolve against the sample resolve for a pixel with one partial mask or one path edge: measured at 1 where pixels switch resolves as a path crosses a moving surface. A pixel that holds a surface silhouette and a path edge together is not bounded by it: a backend resolving such a pixel sample by sample, where the reference took the coverage resolve, lands up to 2 away with the two edges across each other and up to 48 with a stroke along the silhouette.
